referents.why: 'them' (autois) in 'answered them' is the crowd Pilate addresses; the crowd is not among the candidates, so no candidate fits the plural masculine pronoun
referents.category: addressee not offered as a candidate

referents.why: 'to you' (humin), second plural inside Pilate's question, is the crowd he is speaking to; the crowd is not a candidate
referents.category: addressee not offered as a candidate

referents.why: 'you' (thelete, do you want), second plural in the question, is the crowd; not a candidate
referents.category: addressee not offered as a candidate

referents.why: 'I' (apolusō, I should release), first singular inside Pilate's own speech: the speaker of that speech is Pilate
referents.category: first person inside speech is the speaker

links.why: the subjunctive 'I should release' is the complement of 'you want' and sits inside the question
links.category: complement clause nested in verb of wanting

links.why: The participle governs the speech it introduces. Grammar nesting kept beside the content link.
the speech verb (participle lego, saying) introduces the question it says (R1)
the participle 'saying' is the manner of the finite 'answered them'
links.category: participle of speech within finite verb

links.why: self-link; a clause cannot follow itself

groups.why: the part is the said question cl2, not the participle cl1 which is the speech verb inside the frame; the addressee is removed because the crowd is not a candidate
groups.category: turn part is the said clause

none_fit.what: The crowd named in 15:8 is the addressee of Pilate's speech ('them', 'you') but is not offered as a candidate, so those slots are none rather than a choice.

cant_tell.what: the crowd as addressee of Pilate's question (slots w4, w8, cl2s) and so the turn's addressee
cant_tell.why: the crowd is named in Mrk.15.6 and 15.8 but is not offered as a candidate in this verse's list

cant_tell.what: addressee of Pilate's turn (w4, w8, cl2s)
cant_tell.why: The crowd named in Mrk.15.8 is the plural addressee but is not in the candidate list.
